'''Cyndr's Edge''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] obtained from the [[Mountain Heart Chest]], which spawns after killing [[Cyndr the Mountain Heart]] or [[Magmus]] in the [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks]].

== Stats ==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Double [[adrenaline]] on hit (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as a [[Brute Sword]].
